description: This file defines an in-memory fake implementation of the CalendarAccountValidator for testing purposes. It allows adding valid accounts and performing validation without database queries, primarily used in unit tests to mock external dependencies.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarAccountValidator
classes.description: A test double class that simulates CalendarAccountValidator behavior entirely in-memory for unit testing.

methods.name: addValidAccount
methods.description: Adds a CalendarAccount object to the in-memory store after validating its non-empty ID, user ID, and source.

methods.name: validateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarAccount by ID from the in-memory store or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored valid accounts from the in-memory store.
